## Key facts learned (compaction-proof)
- harness-main.ts reqEnv's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR + RUN_SPEC_FILE; launcher (k8s-launcher.ts:117) sets neither
  CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR nor any run-spec → live launch fails at reqEnv. THE gap.
- SeatPolicy.tools is a Set, DenialState.perTarget is a Map → NOT JSON-safe. Deliver CompileInput
  (tools:string[]) over the wire; harness compiles locally. newDenialState() always fresh.
- agent_types.tools text[] (e.g. ["read","write","web_search","web_fetch","subagent","measure"]); run.model_tier
  ∈ base|balanced|frontier maps to tier.
- WORKFLOW_MANIFESTS[workflow] → {workflow,skill,defaultInputs,phases[PhaseManifest]}. PhaseManifest:
  key,index,label,skillPhase,seat,phaseClass,allowsSubagents,budgetShare,completionPredicates.
- @pulumi/kubernetes NOT a dep; GKE cluster has no datapathProvider/networkPolicy; run-task GSA has only
  bucket objectViewer (no artifactregistry.reader); no PGA route/DNS/master-CIDR firewall. infra/pulumi not in
  tsc -b/turbo — its own tsconfig (noEmit) typechecks program; stages.test.ts runs in root vitest.
- runPhase called only in integration/src/harness.ts (FakeEngine). Live path = worker provisions Job → pod
  agent-entry drives startPhase. renderCredits belongs to runPhase (not live-invoked in pod model).

## Architectural finding (record in report)
The live execution model diverged (surfaced by P0.15c): the pod's agent-entry drives engine.startPhase
(runAgentPhase), NOT the server-side runPhase. So renderCredits/provisional-usage/completion-oracle/commit
(all in runPhase) have no live pod-model call-site yet — the same class of gap as "who commits the step after
the pod phase runs." buildHarnessRunSpec (item 1) lets the agent RUN; the post-phase server-side commit loop is
a broader construction gap (Stage B). renderCredits wired where runPhase IS constructed (integration composition).
